candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its POST /v1/orders call to the order service fails with transport errors at ~2s, indicating the order dependency is unreachable or timing out.
candidates.uncertainty: Gateway-side evidence only; order service logs/metrics absent, so whether the failure is latency, connection refusal, or order-internal fault is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Gateway logs show repeated 502s on /v1/checkout paired with transport errors calling order at ~2s, and metrics show elevated p95 (~2406ms) on /v1/checkout. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. Root cause is downstream of the gateway but the specific order-side failure mode is not yet established.
missing_evidence: Order service logs and metrics for POST /v1/orders during the incident window
Order service dependency health (inventory, payment, postgresql) to distinguish latency from connection failure
Gateway client error detail (timeout vs connection refused) for the /v1/orders transport errors
